profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments

positions.title: Associate Application Analyst & Developer
positions.description:
Participated in all phases of complex application analysis and design components based on requirements. Performed complex maintenance and problem resolution on software applications.

* Formulated and defined system scope and objectives through research and fact-finding to develop or modify moderately complex information systems. Prepared detailed design specifications.

* Designed, coded, tested, debugged,  documented and maintained application programs.

* Consulted with users or other IT professionals to resolve issues with programs. Contributed to the development of project plans and timelines. Provided estimates for planned work.

*Maintained and developed business knowledge and customer relationships.
